summary: First testing pass for Raahkar (Persian RTL workflow automation). Backend: 20/20 pytest tests pass (auth, dashboard, workflows CRUD+start, forms CRUD, tasks, comments, processes, AI SSE streaming with claude-sonnet-4-6 via emergentintegrations). Frontend: Login (admin), Dashboard with Persian digits & AI recommendations, sidebar pinned to RTL right edge, Workflows list (2 seeded items), Workflow Builder (reactflow canvas + palette + inspector on node click + save), Inbox (manager sees 2 tasks), Mobile /mobile approvals card all working.

minor.issue: Test pollution: TestWorkflows creates a workflow, starts a process instance, then deletes the workflow, leaving a dangling process_instance. /api/processes/{pid} then returns workflow=None for that orphan. Recommend either cascading delete or refusing delete when running instances exist.
Approving a task does not advance the parent process_instance to the next node nor create the next task. Workflow execution engine is essentially stateless beyond a single approval click.

issues: Console warning from React Flow: nodeTypes/edgeTypes object is recreated on every render. Define them outside component or memoize with useMemo to avoid full canvas re-render — see reactflow.dev/error#002.

action_items: Optional: Memoize nodeTypes/edgeTypes in /app/frontend/src/pages/WorkflowBuilder.js to silence React Flow warning and reduce re-renders.
Optional: Refuse DELETE /api/workflows/{id} when running process_instances reference it, or cascade-delete the instances + tasks to keep /api/processes/{id} consistent.
Consider implementing a minimal state machine that advances process_instance.current_node_id after a task approval and auto-creates the next task; current behaviour only logs an activity.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.hash_password uses unsalted SHA-256 — acceptable for the demo per user choice ("very very simple"), but should be flagged for any production use.
Server uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event hooks. Modern lifespan context manager preferred (won't break anything now).
Workflow update PATCH does not validate node ids referenced by edges; malformed payloads will persist silently.
/api/workflows/{id}/start picks first trigger node or first node — no validation that the workflow is published; drafts can be started too.
test_credentials: admin@raahkar.ir/admin1234, designer@raahkar.ir/1234, manager@raahkar.ir/1234, employee@raahkar.ir/1234 — all working.
seed_data_creation: Seed is idempotent and runs on backend startup. 1 org, 4 users, 2 workflows (مرخصی, تنخواه), 2 forms, 1 running process, 4 tasks, 3 activities — verified via list endpoints.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is order-resilient: it falls back gracefully if previous runs have consumed all seeded pending approvals (because seed is one-shot). The AI streaming test reads SSE chunks until 'event: done' or 45s timeout — already passing. If you re-run, the manager dashboard pending_approvals counter may be 0 after many runs (seed isn't reset); this is expected. Frontend works as designed; only a minor React Flow memoization warning to address.
rca of the issue: N/A — no critical bugs found in this iteration. Two minor observations: (1) Process detail returns workflow=null when the workflow has been deleted while its instance is still running — caused by lack of FK cascade. (2) Task approval doesn't auto-advance the process — engine is intentionally simple.
